items.title: 54270_Doc Cheatham oral history interview
items.q: INTERVIEWER: I know Elmer Snowden told me many times... INTERVIEWEE: Yes, that's true.

ctx.x: Very loud. But he wasn't as tasty as the rest of the guys.
